overview:
The **Battle of Korriban (Ancient)** (6900 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Hundred-Year Darkness**, fought on or above **Korriban**. Dark jedi conquerors dueling native sith kings in korriban tombs with red blades reflecting off desert cliffs and sith holocrons.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Hundred-Year Darkness in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Korriban (Ancient) within the broader **Hundred-Year Darkness** campaign. Front-line reports describe dark jedi conquerors dueling native sith kings in korriban tombs with red blades reflecting off desert cliffs and sith holocrons.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **6900 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Hundred-Year Darkness.
significance: The Battle of Korriban (Ancient) illustrates how the Hundred-Year Darkness reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
